newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending gains.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending gains.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to rise for the third session running on Wednesday, rebounding from falls last month deepened by flooding and selling before the interest rate rise on August 4.
But analysts said the market had limited upside in the run-up to the September 21 parliamentary elections.
They said Rafako, suspended from bourse trade since July 11, should fall on Wednesday when it returns to trade without the daily 10-percent price-fluctuation limit. @
On Monday the firm gave an 18.9-million-zloty preliminary flood damage estimate but said this year's sales forecast of 370 million zlotys had not been changed.
Steel products maker Stalprodukt SA on Wednesday starts trade on the main market.
